subject.title: test(ui): fix Node 25+ localStorage crashes in jsdom suites; document PR-open CI drops

question: Should the repository-wide CI recovery procedure require merge-ref or PR-associated workflow verification before a close/reopen, rather than treating the head SHA as the sole attachment identity?
rationale: This is an operational policy instruction used beyond this PR; maintainers should confirm the intended GitHub Actions identity check before publishing a recovery procedure that can restart contributor CI.

options.title: Correct the recovery check before merge
options.body: Require verification of the pull-request workflow’s merge-ref or PR association, then retain close/reopen only when no valid run exists.

options.title: Keep head-only verification
options.body: Accept that valid merge-ref-associated workflows may be treated as absent and that agents may unnecessarily re-fire CI.

recommendation.title: Correct the recovery check before merge
recommendation.body: Require verification of the pull-request workflow’s merge-ref or PR association, then retain close/reopen only when no valid run exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed repository workflow instruction and have recent related UI/CI contribution context.
